final: WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) as customer_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), overall_total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_total) as total_revenue FROM customer_totals), customer_shares AS (SELECT ct.customer_total, ct.customer_total / ot.total_revenue as share FROM customer_totals ct CROSS JOIN overall_total ot), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_val FROM customer_shares), above_avg_customers AS (SELECT cs.customer_total, cs.share FROM customer_shares cs CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE cs.share > a.avg_share_val) SELECT AVG(customer_total) as avg_spending, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share_val FROM avg_share)) as avg_beat FROM above_avg_customers
